scope: NBA inputs whose status was verified or changed by the Phase 16 production port (nba-edge-finder branch claude/fable-phase-16-production-9u2jw7, nba/pag.py); not committed

inputs.historical_depth: 2001-02..2026-27 in vault snapshot-20261116; model uses 2013-14 onward
inputs.pregame_availability: yes: completed games only; rows filtered to scheduled start < forecast time and ET date < game date (assert_pregame)
inputs.source: sportsdataverse-data GitHub release via pf-1.3's data.ensure_hoopr (same files as the vault snapshot)
inputs.freshness: release checked 2026-11-18 ~19:45Z holds games through 2026-11-17 (about one day behind)

inputs.family: game (G1 team rating inside the full-game model)
inputs.historical_depth: 2001-02..2026-27 in vault; production uses 2026-27 only (2025-26 ratings frozen as prior)
inputs.pregame_availability: yes: completed games before the game date
inputs.freshness: same release cadence as player box (not separately timed)

inputs.family: periods (Q1-Q4, H1, H2 totals and team totals)
inputs.input: regulation quarter scores from ESPN schedule linescores (espn_nba_schedules)
inputs.historical_depth: 2019-20..2026-27 (10,097 games; 10,094 internally consistent); no linescores before 2019-20
inputs.pregame_availability: yes: completed games before the game date
inputs.source: data.ensure_hoopr (nba_schedule kind, newly used by production)
inputs.freshness: release checked 2026-11-18: all completed games through 2026-11-17 have linescores

inputs.input: pf-1.3 published participation probability p_play per listed player
inputs.historical_depth: archived on projection-data for 2026-27 only (pregame variant validated on 194 games)
inputs.pregame_availability: yes: produced by the same projection run; captured_utc must be <= forecast time (asserted)
inputs.source: nba.project.project_slate players[].participation (official injury report, ESPN injuries, starters)

inputs.family: game, periods (starter-strength term of Q1/Q3 margin equations)
inputs.historical_depth: none archived (data-lineup-pit branch does not exist yet)
inputs.pregame_availability: would be ~5-45 min before tip once the capture workflow runs

inputs.input: pbp-derived possessions, pace, ORtg/DRtg per game-team (Phase 16 agent: lineup/pbp)
inputs.historical_depth: 2015-16..2026-27 to 2026-11-16: 14,330 games (reg+playoffs), 28,658 team rows; score reconciled 99.8-100% per season; event possessions vs box formula r=0.86-0.93, event count 3.0 below 0.44-FTA formula on average
inputs.pregame_availability: yes as rolling features of completed games (point-in-time asserted by truncation test, max diff 0); same-night pbp is postgame only
inputs.source: sift-data-vault NBA espn_pbp snapshot-20261118 (2015-16..2023-24, vault commit 82b9a0f on claude/sift-phase-15-sports-forecasting-rz966p) + espn_pbp_boxes_schedules snapshot-20261116 (2024-25..2026-27 pbp, boxes); builder research/phase16/NBA/build_pbp_lineup_features.py
inputs.freshness: vault snapshot 2026-11-16 (games through ~2026-11-16); production would need the daily sportsdataverse pbp release
inputs.note: E1: no gain over PAG for winner/spread/total (all CIs include 0); not recommended for the production model

inputs.input: starters history (5 per team-game) from box starter flags, independently re-derived from pbp period-1 lineups
inputs.historical_depth: 2015-16..2026-27: box has 5 flagged starters for 99.3-100% of team-games; pbp-inferred starters equal box flags in 99.9-100%
inputs.pregame_availability: historical only (postgame box). Pregame equivalent = confirmed-starter capture (#115), not running
inputs.source: sift-data-vault NBA espn_pbp snapshot-20261118 (2015-16..2023-24, vault commit 82b9a0f on claude/sift-phase-15-sports-forecasting-rz966p) + espn_pbp_boxes_schedules snapshot-20261116 (2024-25..2026-27 pbp, boxes); builder research/phase16/NBA/build_pbp_lineup_features.py
inputs.note: E2 upper bound: knowing actual starters adds no robust gain to #116 Q1/H1 totals, team totals or spreads (deltas <=0.02 pts MAE, sign inconsistent across seasons)

inputs.input: lineup stints from pbp substitutions: starting-unit minutes share and net rating, bench (<=2 starters) net rating, starters' minutes by quarter, per-player on-court net
inputs.historical_depth: 2015-16..2026-27, same coverage; lineups with !=5 players on court 0.06-1.4% of seconds (worst 2017-18..2019-20)
inputs.pregame_availability: yes as rolling prior-game features (asserted); actual-starter variants require confirmed lineups
inputs.source: sift-data-vault NBA espn_pbp snapshot-20261118 (2015-16..2023-24, vault commit 82b9a0f on claude/sift-phase-15-sports-forecasting-rz966p) + espn_pbp_boxes_schedules snapshot-20261116 (2024-25..2026-27 pbp, boxes); builder research/phase16/NBA/build_pbp_lineup_features.py
inputs.note: E3: starting-unit margin adjustment on split improves H1 spread ladder log loss in 2025-26 (-0.0037) and H1 margin MAE in 2025-26/2026-27, but does not change calibration (slopes already 0.96-1.01 in full seasons); not adopted
